description: List geometry information. If a geometry set is not specified via the set keyword and no other keywords are specified then information about all geometry sets is listed. Otherwise, if no set is specified then information about the current geometry set is listed.

description.7.0: List of all information about the specified or current geometry set.
description.9.0: List of all information about the specified or current geometry set.

description.7.0: List of node information for the specified or current geometry set. Options: edges: List edge information of the nodes.; extra <i>: List the extra variable at index i .; group [slot <s>]: List group information. An optional slot can be specified.; information: List groups and extras for the nodes.
